skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of cloud computing and related architecture principles.
Design and implement security architectures for cloud services.
Ensure secure isolation of physical and logical infrastructure.
Protect data across all layers of the OSI model.
Manage access control for cloud-based services.
Implement monitoring and auditing processes for cloud services.
Apply various cloud security design patterns.
Manage identities within cloud computing environments.
Understand and apply compliance standards such as ISO, NIST, ENISA.
Develop the ability to learn independently and take responsibility for personal and group work.
Plan, coordinate, manage resources, assess and improve the efficiency of activities.
Analyze and evaluate cloud security solutions.
Practically solve and configure security mechanisms for real-world problems.
Demonstrate organizational discipline, cooperation, and personal responsibility.
Find, collect, synthesize, and present security issues in databases and applications.
Use tools to enhance the security of software systems and databases.
